_doc: Which sim runs each model trains and is scored on. Paths are relative to the repo root; globs allowed; missing paths are skipped with a warning. A run matched by more than one split goes to the first of: val, stop, train. val = held-out scoring runs (compare.py default). stop = early stopping only (MLP/GNN), never scored. train = everything models fit on. 1k and 7k runs mix freely; each run is one graph.
